definition: A court docket contains a brief list of upcoming court proceedings and filings, so the court is able to keep track of multiple cases. Most dockets contain:  a docket number, which identifies the number of the case  history of the case, which lists all of the events that have occurred in a case  decision date  the name of the court the case is currently in  the questions presented in the case  party names Court dockets are generally considered to be public records.
